name: rhp-lua-tests
description: Runs Rhp::test Lua test files (busted / Jest style) in the Test Explorer: failures in place, diffs, output, costs and line coverage.

rhpTests.command.markdownDescription: The runner and its leading arguments: a program's own test executable (`["build/lua_tests"]`, its real libs) or `["rhp-cli", "test"]` (the `rhp` API, or fakes with `--api`).

rhpTests.args.markdownDescription: More runner arguments, such as `["-s", "scripts"]` (module folders) or `["--isolation", "test"]`.

rhpTests.include.description: Test files, relative to the workspace folder.

rhpTests.exclude.description: Folders never searched for test files.

commands.title: RHP: Run Lua tests and update snapshots
